import cmath

TOL = 1e-9

def poly_eval(coeffs, z):
    # coeffs are low-to-high degree
    acc = 0j
    for c in reversed(coeffs):
        acc = acc * z + c
    return acc

def prod_linear(roots):
    # exact expansion of prod(z - r) as low-to-high coefficients
    poly = [1 + 0j]
    for r in roots:
        new = [0j] * (len(poly) + 1)
        for i, c in enumerate(poly):
            new[i + 1] += c
            new[i] += -r * c
        poly = new
    return poly

# (name, coefficients low-to-high of monic p, roots of p with multiplicity)
cases = [
    ("z^2+1",  [1, 0, 1],       [1j, -1j]),
    ("z^2",    [0, 0, 1],       [0, 0]),
    ("z-3",    [-3, 1],         [3]),
    ("z^3-z",  [0, -1, 0, 1],   [0, 1, -1]),
]

all_claim_holds = True
all_b_zero = True

for name, p, roots in cases:
    n = len(p) - 1
    # validity: each listed root is a root of p, and the multiset has size n
    roots_ok = len(roots) == n and all(abs(poly_eval(p, r)) < TOL for r in roots)

    q = prod_linear(roots)  # exact product over the roots
    diffs = [q[i] - p[i] for i in range(n + 1)]
    nonconst_zero = all(abs(diffs[i]) < TOL for i in range(1, n + 1))
    b = diffs[0]            # the constant b with p(z)+b = prod(z - z_i)
    claimed = -p[0]         # submitted answer -p(0)

    print(f"p = {name}: roots_valid={roots_ok}, identity_nonconst_match={nonconst_zero}")
    print(f"  computed b = {b.real:.6f}{b.imag:+.6f}j")
    print(f"  claimed b  = -p(0) = {claimed}")
    print(f"  match = {abs(b - claimed) < TOL}")

    if not (roots_ok and nonconst_zero):
        print("  UNSUPPORTED: root or identity check failed for this case")
    all_claim_holds = all_claim_holds and abs(b - claimed) < TOL
    all_b_zero = all_b_zero and abs(b) < TOL

print()
print("Literal reading: p(z) = prod(z - z_i) for monic p, so b must be 0 in every case.")
print(f"All computed b equal 0: {all_b_zero}")
print("Sampling note: four exact cases were tested; a single failing case disproves the universal claim.")
if all_claim_holds:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
